integrity: All analytic formulas are stated with ranges and boundaries and supported by an exact-rational standalone verifier; finite computations are supplements, not the proof. No external independent assessment has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact results only for the unit-frequency linear harmonic oscillator and specified fixed-step position-/velocity-Verlet maps. The equal-probability law governs expected physical energy, not almost-sure stability. General mixing implies a growing second-moment mode without giving an exponential lower bound for every initial vector. The fixed deterministic alternating phase boundary does not address nonperiodic switching or nonlinear problems. Publication precedence of older specialized mixed-order Verlet calculations is not fully excluded.
title: Randomized Verlet ordering: exact energy inflation and an alternating stability boundary
